sentences.japanese: なにも彼の過去のミスを償うことはできないでしょう。
sentences.english: Nothing will make up for his past mistakes.

sentences.japanese: できる限りの償いはするつもりだ。
sentences.english: I promise you every possible compensation.

sentences.japanese: だれがその損害を償うのですか。
sentences.english: Who will compensate for the loss?

sentences.japanese: その損害は保険金で償われた。
sentences.english: The damage was covered by insurance.
